newsitem.title: UK: Michael Grade joins Charlton Athletic FC board.
newsitem.headline: Michael Grade joins Charlton Athletic FC board.

text.p: First Leisure Corp Plc chairman Michael Grade is joining the board of English first division soccer club Charlton Athletic as a non-executive director, the London club said in a statement on Monday.
Charlton announced last month that they plan to raise some six million pounds from a flotation on the Alternative Investment Market.

"Michael Grade's experience of the television and leisure sectors will be invaluable to us as we seek to implement our ambitious plans to develop Charlton in the coming years," club chairman Richard Murray said.
Grade, a life-long Charlton fan, is shortly to step down as chief executive of Channel 4 television after nine years in the job.
He is to become executive chairman of bingo and nightclubs group First Leisure, a company where he is already non-executive head.
Grade said he was "honoured" to become a Charlton director. "I hope I can make a real contribution to the future success of Charlton," he added.
